display.purpose: The single experiment h1 in each page intro.

body.purpose: Default prose and native control text.

label.purpose: Badges, readouts and compact metadata in mono.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Local focus/selection ring in mosaic-maker; no ambient shadow exists at rest.

components.name: Shared Button
components.description: Transparent hairline button used in panels and on light pages.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 4px; background-color: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { background-color: var(--pg-color-neutral); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pg-color-aurora); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:active { background-color: var(--pg-dark0Soft); } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat, translucent container over the radial aurora wash.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--pg-color-neutral); border-radius: 6px; background-color: var(--pg-surface-background); color: var(--pg-surface-foreground); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small monospaced label for tiers and values.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--pg-font-mono); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Native text field styled with the shared surface and hairline border.
components.css: .ds-input { padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 4px; background-color: var(--pg-surface-background); color: inherit; font: inherit; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--pg-color-aurora); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Status Pills
components.description: Compact mono status indicators for ok, error and pending states.
components.html: Prêt Erreur En cours
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--pg-font-mono); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-status--ok { border: 1px solid var(--pg-color-solder); background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--pg-color-solder) 12%, transparent); color: var(--pg-color-solder); } .ds-status--error { border: 1px solid var(--pg-color-error); background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--pg-color-error) 12%, transparent); color: var(--pg-color-error); } .ds-status--pending { border: 1px solid var(--pg-color-amber); background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--pg-color-amber) 12%, transparent); color: var(--pg-color-amber); }

components.name: Canvas Viewport
components.description: Dark well that hosts a 2D or WebGL2 canvas.
components.css: .ds-canvas-viewport { position: relative; display: flex; flex: 1; min-height: 280px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--pg-color-neutral); border-radius: 6px; background-color: var(--pg-dark0Hard); } .ds-canvas { display: block; flex: 1; width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 280px; touch-action: none; } .ds-canvas-viewport:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--pg-color-aurora); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Card Link
components.description: Index link that turns its card border aurora on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--pg-color-neutral); border-radius: 6px; background-color: var(--pg-surface-background); color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-card:hover { border-color: var(--pg-color-aurora); background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--pg-color-aurora) 8%, transparent); } .ds-nav-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pg-color-aurora); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-card { transition: none; } }

components.name: Loading Indicator
components.css: .ds-loading { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--pg-color-aurora); font-family: var(--pg-font-mono); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-loading::before { content: ""; width: 12px; height: 12px; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-top-color: transparent; border-radius: 9999px; animation: ds-spin 200ms linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-loading::before { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
pg_lab looks like a working notebook left open on an instrument bench: warm paper grounds, charcoal ink, hairline rules, and a small set of OKLCH signal colors that behave like labels on dials. The canvas is the loudest thing on screen; the interface around it stays precise, playful, and deliberately unspectacular. The voice is instrumented — readouts, status lines and short labels — rather than marketing copy. The rejected reference is the generic SaaS dashboard: no metric grids, no product-marketing chrome, no invented brand mythology.

Density is low to moderate. An experiment is a stage plus a 320px control panel; an index is a short list of quietly bordered cards. Everything is native HTML in light DOM: no framework, no shadow DOM, no component runtime. Motion is short (120–320ms) and only ever clarifies state.

Depth is layered, not lifted. Translucent surfaces sit over a five-radial aurora wash and are separated by 1px hairlines. The chosen direction of soft, layered cards is expressed through this translucent stacking, modest radii and tonal separation; the incumbent system has no ambient drop-shadow token, and none should be invented to fake softness.
keyCharacteristics: OKLCH as the only color language, with bright and faded pairs per theme.
Stage-first hierarchy: the generated image dominates, the panel recedes.
Hairline borders and 4–6px radii; surfaces are flat at rest.
French interface copy, English code, docs and identifiers.

rules.name: The Border-Only Neutral Rule
rules.body: `--pg-color-neutral` never carries text. Secondary text always uses `--pg-text-muted`, the AA-verified token.

rules.name: The Theme-Pair Rule
rules.body: Every semantic color has a bright light value and a faded dark value. Never reuse a bright value under `[data-theme="dark"]`.

rules.name: The Accent-as-Signal Rule
rules.body: Teal Signal / Dusk Blue marks navigation, focus and state. It never becomes a large surface fill.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Values, statuses, badges, stats and code are mono. Prose and interactive controls stay sans.

rules.name: The Stage-First Rule
rules.body: The stage takes all remaining space. The panel is a fixed 320px default and never grows into the stage.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards and panels are flat at rest. Softness comes from translucent layering and modest radii, not from drop shadows.

rules.name: The Halo-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow may only be a focus or selection ring. If a new surface needs separation, use a hairline or a surface tint first.

rules.name: The Quiet-Corner Rule
rules.body: Default to 4px on controls and 6px on containers. Reserve 8px for experiment-local panels and 9999px for pills and circular controls.

dos: **Do** use `--pg-*` tokens in experiment stylesheets; palette data colors such as swatches are the only exception.
**Do** keep the 44px touch target on buttons and the 2px aurora focus outline on interactive elements.
**Do** use `--pg-text-muted` for secondary text, verified at 5.75:1 light and 5.30:1 dark.
**Do** keep interface copy in French and code, docs and identifiers in English.
**Do** build tints with `color-mix(in oklab, ...)` so they follow the active theme.
donts: **Don't** hard-code hex or rgb colors, spacing or sizes in experiment `styles.css`.
**Don't** use `--pg-color-neutral` for text; it is a border token.
**Don't** add ambient drop shadows or backdrop blur; layered translucency and hairlines provide depth.
**Don't** introduce a framework, shadow DOM or component runtime into an experiment page.
**Don't** import webfonts; the system sans and system mono stacks are the specified pairing.
**Don't** use custom properties inside `@media` conditions; mirror 720px and 1024px numerically.
